title: After 2 patient deaths and cell therapy durability concerns, Artiva cuts 94% of workforce
snippet: Artiva Biotherapeutics, which had been evaluating cell therapy AlloNK for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and other autoimmune diseases, is exploring strategic options that could include dissolution and liquidation.

title: EMSO 2026: Incyte a ‘firm contender’ in G12D pancreatic cancer race as early candidate shines
snippet: In a Phase 1 study, treatment with Incyte's KRAS G12D inhibitor in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy elicited an 89% confirmed objective response rate in patients with a type of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, leading analysts to draw comparisons with Revolution Medicines’ zoldonrasib.

title: Alphabet’s GV is one of biotech’s most influential corporate investors
snippet: The corporate investor arms of Eli Lilly, Sanofi and Pfizer have participated in billions worth of venture capital rounds, but GV is the industry’s biggest spender.

title: Novartis faces $1.9B hit from Avidity fail but maintains confidence in $12B buy
snippet: Novartis remains "very happy" with its $12 billion acquisition of Avidity Biosciences, despite a Phase 3 disappointment for the antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate del-desiran.

snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a lethal cancer characterized by a high abundance of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), which influence therapy response, tumor biology and tumor aggressiveness. title: Schwann cell reprogramming and immune regulation in the cancer microenvironment.
snippet: Schwann cells are peripheral glia with established roles in nerve support and repair.
